for st in ['Đã hủy','Đổi trả','Đang giao','Xong']:
    sub = df[df['Kết quả']==st]
    print(st, 'Thanh tien not empty count:', df[df['Kết quả']==st]['Thanh tien'].str.contains('.').sum(), '/', round(100*len(sub)/len(df),1))

# Revenue per day = sum Thanh tien for non-cancelled, non-returned (Xong + Đang giao)

    v = str(v).replace('.', '').replace(',', '').replace('₫','').strip()
    return v
df['tl_amount'] = df['Thanh tien'].apply(clean)

# Parse dates for July 2026 explicitly

daily = daily.sort_values('day')

top = daily.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False).head(10)
